name: Wylde Pak
description: Lily and Jack are half-siblings thrown together for a summer who must learn how to navigate their new family dynamic while also helping with the Wylde Pak family's chaotic pet grooming business.

videos.title: Best Summer Ever?
videos.overview: Jack and Lily are half-siblings living on opposite ends of the world — until Jack shows up on Lily's doorstep for the summer. Their arguing sends the family's new grooming trailer careening through town and they must save their family's livelihood and Halmoni, who is stuck inside.

videos.title: Sad, Single, and Stranded
videos.overview: Will and Min show Jack around to help him find a good story. Lily spills boba in Jack's suitcase and tries to hide the evidence.

videos.title: A Waste of a Perfect Summer Day
videos.overview: Jack tries to find the big picture as Lily shows him how to spend a perfect summer day in Canyon Valley.

videos.title: Woori World
videos.overview: Lily and Jack embark on the epic quest of navigating their local Asian market, Woori World, competing to find a highly coveted box of imported Hallasand cookies.

videos.title: Finding FlamingoFan85
videos.overview: When someone trashes the Groom & Board with a nasty online review, Lily won't rest until she finds out who FlamingoFan85 really is. With Jack's help, the mystery only gets weirder.

videos.title: Just a Little Pipe Problem
videos.overview: When Jack and Lily mess up the plumbing at the Groom & Board, things spiral fast! While Min and Jack rush to the hardware store for a fix, Lily and Will try to clean up the mess.

videos.title: Camp Chuck
videos.overview: Chuck's got a new hustle: theatre camp! Jack and Lily are sure it's a scam, but there's more to the chaotic show than they realized.

videos.title: The Three Ravens
videos.overview: Ellie and the kids investigate cryptic Mrs. Withers, but when Jack goes missing in her creepy home, Ellie and Lily must save him.

videos.title: Left Holding the Bag
videos.overview: Eager to become master criminals, Lily and Jack help Chuck with his dirty laundry, but are they ready for a life of crime?

videos.title: The Meatball of Canyon Valley
videos.overview: When Halmoni chooses Jack over Lily to be her Trot dance competition partner, a jealous Lily seeks revenge.

videos.title: Sticky Fingers
videos.overview: Min asks Jack to run a simple errand, but Charlie the Gibbon intervenes, sending Jack and Lily chasing after him.

videos.title: Warriors Against the Realm
videos.overview: Lily introduces Jack to her favorite video game, but when he keeps losing, Jack binges the game and turns into a toxic troll.

videos.title: Sungandeul
videos.overview: Slice of life vignettes that illustrate the modern-day family dynamic.

videos.title: The Boba-Get
videos.overview: The kids try to save the café using pucker limes, but are quickly forced to save Canyon Valley from the pucker.

videos.title: Be Your Own Bean
videos.overview: Lily and Min both realize how similar they are to their moms.

videos.title: Meats of Strength
videos.overview: Beef invites Jack to a sleepover, but Jack, a sleepover newbie, freaks out over impressing his friend.

videos.title: Dead Ed's
videos.overview: Jack and Lily try to prove they're the one true local, enduring a series of bizarre quests in the local dive.

videos.title: The Secret of Lake Island
videos.overview: Lily introduces Jack to the deserted Lake Island theme park. When they get stranded, their new friendship quickly crumbles.

videos.title: Father, Son, and Furniture Store
videos.overview: Will tries to connect with Jack at the oddball store Mike A's, but everything goes awry and they must fight.

videos.title: LAD
videos.overview: Lily and her BFFs Anusha and Debs fight to win the coveted trophy at Hank n Beans arcade.

videos.title: Before 10am
videos.overview: Determined to learn the truth about Jack's secret morning life, Lily does the unthinkable and wakes up early but her sleuthing gets them both in big trouble.

videos.title: Mrs. Withers' Parables
videos.overview: In an anthology of Halloween stories told by Mrs. Withers, Min encounters a terrifying doppelganger, Will fends off a Toastpocalypse, Jack and Lily bury the wrong pet, and the kids get sucked into a video game.

videos.title: Where There's a Will, There's a Way
videos.overview: During a heatwave, Will tries to fix the broken air conditioning to protect his family.

videos.title: Lost in Sauce
videos.overview: Ellie's bossy behavior at Raven Club makes Jack and Lil quit, forcing her to save her friendships and her investigation.

videos.title: Journey to the Otter Side
videos.overview: The family is excited to take Jack to Lake World, Lily's favorite theme park. However, after a disappointing day, they discover Lily's favorite ride has vanished. The children must embark on a thrilling adventure to find it and save their holiday.

videos.title: Basic Zipper Merging Etiquette
videos.overview: The family gets stuck in a traffic jam that leads to all human civility getting thrown out the passenger side window.

videos.title: How to Bag a Beast
videos.overview: Jack and Lily attempt to catch a legendary town fish, despite horror stories from townsfolk who have tried and failed before them.

videos.title: Follow the Sprinkles
videos.overview: When Lily begins digging to discover why her favorite ice cream van is selling shaved ice, she uncovers a town-wide conspiracy.

videos.title: Canyon Valley V. Dirk
videos.overview: Dirk is wrongly accused of stealing a Canyon Valley landmark, so Min comes out of retirement as a lawyer to help him.

videos.title: Wrong Text
videos.overview: Jack gets his first phone and immediately sends the wrong text to Will, forcing the kids to do whatever it takes to delete it.

videos.title: Emergency Family Tribunal
videos.overview: When the last hallasand goes missing, fingers point to Halmoni and only a family tribunal will set the record straight.

videos.title: J-LAD
videos.overview: Jack hangs with LAD, but his desperate attempts to fit in have disastrous consequences.

videos.title: Big Honey
videos.overview: Jack and Lil both think they are entitled to their grandparents bee farm. But when they realize that Grandma and Grandpa Wylde intend to sell it to a major corporation, they must team up to stop the deal at all costs.

videos.title: Caught Rubber-Handed
videos.overview: Chuck moves in with the Wylde-Paks after Lily and Jack accidentally destroy his house, but they must hide his awful roommate habits from their parents.

videos.title: And... Action!
videos.overview: Seeking closure on her favorite K-Drama, Lily films her own finale with her family as the cast and crew.

videos.title: Prison Break
videos.overview: When Jack and Lil are grounded by Will and Min, who are then grounded by Halmoni, the family team up to escape their punishment.

videos.title: Canyon Valley Film Festival
videos.overview: Canyon Valley hosts a festival and Jack’s excited to enter, until the pressure to deliver a masterpiece gets to him.

videos.title: Dubu
videos.overview: Halmoni falls in love with a customer's dog, and rather than return him, she dog-naps him and goes on the lam.

videos.title: Jack's Day Off
videos.overview: Jack volunteers to run the Groom & Board solo, but when a pet snake causes chaos he must protect the other pets from the jaws of death!

videos.title: Summer Chuseok
videos.overview: In an attempt to get out of the dentist, Lily insists on a summer celebration of the fall holiday Chuseok.

videos.title: Putting Up with the Plovers
videos.overview: When Will accidentally befriends an annoying man, his sorry attempts at a break-up make things painfully awkward for the whole family.

videos.title: The Real Woori World
videos.overview: Min tries to avoid the usual Woori World chaos, but when the family splits up, they all get lost in their own fiascos.

videos.title: The Collector
videos.overview: Jack’s mission to find the rare DVD sequel of his favorite movie leads him to the mysterious Collector.

videos.title: Halmoni Learns the Internet
videos.overview: Halmoni feels she looks helpless about technology, so she becomes a master hacker and vows to destroy their internet forever.

videos.title: The Library
videos.overview: Lily must retrieve a book from the dreaded library, a horrifying maze of unknown terrors.

videos.title: Date Night
videos.overview: Will and Min’s date ends up in a rideshare turf war. Meanwhile, at home, Halmoni throws a party as the kids try to prove they can watch themselves.

videos.title: Behind the Jingle
videos.overview: The family gets famous after their Groom & Board Jingle hits #1, but fame is fickle and tears them apart.

videos.title: Best Summer Ever!
videos.overview: The end of the summer has arrived and the family throws Jack a goodbye party, but he only cares about impressing his mom when she comes to Canyon Valley. When she arrives at the airport, the kids go on a wild adventure to get Jack there on time.
